topic: Internal scrape gets 403 after adding proxy
environment: Internal HTTP endpoint scraped by an integration
symptom_pattern: As soon as the proxy was configured so the Agent could reach Datadog, an integration that scrapes an internal endpoint started failing with HTTP 403 from the proxy.
root_cause: With proxy settings applied globally, integration HTTP requests to internal hosts are also routed through the proxy, whose ACL only allows Datadog domains. The internal host isn't listed in proxy.no_proxy.
resolution_path: Check the integration error (403 with proxy headers)
Add the internal host/IP to proxy.no_proxy (or set skip_proxy in the instance)

qa_pairs.tse_question: Is the 403 coming from the exporter or the proxy?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: The error page says squid, so I guess the proxy?

qa_pairs.tse_question: Do you have a no_proxy list configured?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: No, we only set http and https.

customer_style.tone: cooperative, a bit overwhelmed by networking details
